We report the 'Strict Accuracy' metric..., we report pass@10 accuracy..., we report the percentage of non-toxic model responses.

• IFEval (Helpfulness) : We use the default setup and report the "Strict Accuracy" metric at the prompt level, i.e. the percentage of prompts for which a model's output satisfies all verifiable instructions. • Alpaca Eval 2.0 (Helpfulness) : ... reporting the length-controlled winrate. • MBPP (Coding) : We report pass@10 accuracy... • HumanEval (Coding) ... report pass@10 accuracy... • Toxigen (Harmlessness) : ... report the percentage of non-toxic model responses.
To run AlpacaEval, we use the original alpaca_eval codebase. For the remaining benchmarks, we use the open-instruct codebase.
